name: GL_SUSPENSE_ACCOUNTS
description: GL_SUSPENSE_ACCOUNTS contains the additional suspense accounts you have specified for each source and category. This is the base table for the Suspense Accounts form in your Oracle General Ledger application. The posting program in your Oracle General Ledger application uses the suspense account you specify in the Suspense Accounts form to balance journal entries where running debits and running credits are not equal.

columns.name: SUSPENSE_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Suspense account identifier for the record.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Journal source code using the suspense account.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: Journal category code using the suspense account.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
